title: **The Collapse of the Myth of America's "Impregnable Fortress" in Al-Azraq**
text:
**The Collapse of the Myth of America's "Impregnable Fortress" in Al-Azraq**"

"The Al-Azraq base in Jordan—one of CENTCOM’s most critical operational hubs—was meant to be America's most secure stronghold in West Asia. Today, however, it has become a symbol of how that very notion has failed."

"This clip recounts how Iranian missile and drone strikes managed to penetrate the base's defensive systems and electronic warfare countermeasures, effectively challenging—and dismantling—the American myth of an "invulnerable safe zone.
